services.name: Oracle Cloud Always Free Compute
services.duration: No expiry while offer remains available
services.quota: Ampere A1: 1,500 OCPU-hours + 9,000 GB-hours/month (roughly 2 OCPU + 12 GB RAM continuously); up to two AMD E2.1.Micro instances; 200 GB Always Free block storage
services.goodFor: A real Linux VM, Docker, small APIs, self-hosted tools, schedulers and learning infrastructure
services.limits: Home-region only; idle compute can be reclaimed; capacity can be unavailable in some regions
services.commercialUse: Check current Oracle terms for your workload

services.name: Google Compute Engine e2-micro
services.quota: One non-preemptible e2-micro VM/month in selected US regions + 30 GB-month standard persistent disk + 1 GB outbound transfer
services.goodFor: Small always-on Linux services, SSH labs, cron jobs and tiny container workloads
services.limits: Only selected US regions; GPU/TPU not included; egress quota is small
services.commercialUse: Allowed subject to Google Cloud terms

services.name: BigQuery Free Tier / Sandbox
services.duration: Monthly free tier; sandbox available without billing
services.quota: 1 TiB query data processed/month + 10 GiB storage/month; Sandbox has a 10 GiB lifetime storage limit and 60-day table expiration
services.goodFor: SQL practice on large public datasets, cost-per-TB experiments and warehouse learning
services.limits: Sandbox omits some features such as streaming and has automatic table expiration
services.commercialUse: Free usage tier follows Google Cloud terms

services.name: Azure SQL Database Free Amount
services.quota: Up to 10 databases, each with 100,000 vCore-seconds serverless usage/month and 32 GB storage
services.goodFor: SQL Server-compatible labs, APIs, small relational projects and BI prototypes
services.limits: Serverless quota; usage outside included amounts can bill if account permits it
services.commercialUse: Allowed subject to Azure terms

services.name: Azure Functions Free Grant
services.quota: 1 million requests/month included in the free grant
services.goodFor: Event-driven Python, HTTP APIs, schedulers and cloud-function learning
services.limits: Execution/resource grants and dependent services can have separate pricing
services.commercialUse: Allowed subject to Azure terms

services.name: Azure Container Apps Free Grant
services.quota: 180,000 vCPU-seconds + 360,000 GiB-seconds + 2 million requests/month
services.goodFor: FastAPI, containerized APIs, background workers and serverless-container learning
services.limits: Networking, registries, storage and additional consumption are separate
services.commercialUse: Allowed subject to Azure terms

services.name: Cloudflare Workers
services.quota: 100,000 requests/day; 10 ms CPU/invocation; 128 MB memory; static assets are free and unlimited
services.goodFor: Edge APIs, lightweight functions, webhooks, auth middleware and static+serverless apps
services.limits: 10 ms CPU cap makes heavy Python/data processing a poor fit
services.commercialUse: Check Cloudflare plan terms for your workload

services.name: Cloudflare D1
services.quota: 5 million rows read/day + 100,000 rows written/day on Workers Free
services.goodFor: SQLite-style edge applications, small APIs and globally distributed app prototypes
services.limits: Not a replacement for large analytical warehouses or heavy transactional databases
services.commercialUse: Check Cloudflare plan terms

services.name: MongoDB Atlas Free Cluster
services.quota: One Free cluster per Atlas project on supported AWS, Azure or GCP regions
services.goodFor: Document databases, FastAPI backends, prototypes and MongoDB learning
services.limits: Small shared development tier with a subset of Atlas functionality
services.commercialUse: Suitable for small development/POC use; check Atlas terms

services.name: Neon Free Postgres
services.quota: 100 projects; each project includes 100 CU-hours/month, 0.5 GB database storage and 10 branches
services.goodFor: Serverless Postgres, preview databases, branching, FastAPI/Next.js apps and CI environments
services.limits: Scale-to-zero and per-project compute/storage quotas; free limits can change
services.commercialUse: Free plan supports early projects; check current Neon terms

services.name: Supabase Free
services.quota: 2 active projects; 500 MB database/project; 1 GB file storage; 5 GB egress; 500,000 Edge Function invocations; 50,000 MAU
services.goodFor: Postgres + Auth + Storage + Realtime + Edge Functions in one lab
services.limits: Projects pause after inactivity; no automatic backups on Free
services.commercialUse: Suitable for hobby/early projects; check Supabase terms

services.name: Aiven Free Tier
services.quota: Always-on capped free plans for PostgreSQL, MySQL, Kafka, OpenSearch and Valkey
services.goodFor: Hosted Kafka or database learning without operating the servers yourself
services.limits: Sandbox-sized resource caps; production features and larger resources require paid plans
services.commercialUse: Check Aiven service terms

services.name: MotherDuck Lite
services.quota: 10 GB storage + 10 hours Pulse compute/month
services.goodFor: Cloud DuckDB, SQL/Parquet analytics, Python/SQL labs and lightweight analytical apps
services.limits: Individual queries use a single DuckDB node; free plan has consumption caps
services.commercialUse: Free-account usage has plan restrictions; check current terms

services.name: Databricks Free Edition
services.quota: One serverless workspace; serverless-only compute; daily fair-use limits; one Lakebase project/account
services.goodFor: Spark/SQL notebooks, Delta Lake, Lakeflow pipelines, ML/AI learning and Databricks practice
services.limits: Personal/non-commercial; no classic compute; limited compute sizes and administrative features
services.commercialUse: No — Free Edition is for learning/training and non-commercial use

services.name: dbt Developer
services.quota: 1 developer seat; 1 project; 3,000 successful models built/month; browser IDE and basic orchestration
services.goodFor: Learning dbt with hosted IDE, scheduling and Git integration
services.limits: Single-developer scope and build quota; team/API/advanced features require higher plans
services.commercialUse: Check dbt plan terms; dbt local distribution/OSS is separately free

services.name: GitHub Actions
services.cardRequired: No paid plan required for included use
services.quota: Standard GitHub-hosted runners are free for public repos; GitHub Free private repos include 2,000 minutes/month
services.goodFor: Build/test/deploy pipelines, scheduled jobs, package builds and open-source CI
services.limits: Private-repo quotas; larger runners and extra storage can bill
services.commercialUse: Allowed within GitHub plan terms

services.name: GitLab Free
services.quota: 400 compute minutes/month + 10 GiB storage; 5 users per private top-level group
services.goodFor: Git hosting, CI/CD and GitLab Pages with one integrated DevOps platform
services.limits: Shared-runner quota is much smaller than GitHub Free private-repo quota
services.commercialUse: Allowed within GitLab Free terms

services.name: Vercel Hobby
services.quota: 1M function invocations/month, 4 active CPU hours/month and 360 GB-hours provisioned memory included
services.goodFor: Next.js, React, serverless APIs, previews and personal web projects
services.limits: Hard Hobby usage caps; intended as a personal-project starting tier
services.commercialUse: Review Hobby plan terms for commercial use

services.name: Netlify Free
services.quota: 300 monthly usage credits across production deploys, compute, bandwidth and web requests
services.goodFor: Static/React sites, previews, forms and lightweight serverless functions
services.limits: Credit model combines several resources; production deploys and bandwidth consume the same pool
services.commercialUse: Review current Netlify Free plan terms

services.name: Render Free Web Service
services.quota: 750 free instance-hours/month; free web service shape is 0.1 CPU / 512 MB RAM
services.goodFor: FastAPI, Flask, Node and small container/web-service demos
services.limits: Spins down after 15 minutes idle; cold start around a minute; local filesystem is ephemeral
services.commercialUse: Designed for hobby/testing/preview; check Render terms

services.name: Koyeb Free Instance
services.quota: One free service instance: 0.1 vCPU + 512 MB RAM
services.goodFor: Small FastAPI/container services and lightweight always-on demos
services.limits: Very small CPU/RAM; database free instance has separate 5-hours/month compute limit
services.commercialUse: Check Koyeb plan terms

services.name: Microsoft Fabric Trial
services.cardRequired: No credit card required; tenant eligibility applies
services.quota: 64 CU trial capacity + up to 1 TB OneLake storage; broad access to Fabric workloads
services.goodFor: Fabric notebooks, Lakehouse, Warehouse, Data Factory, Real-Time and Power BI learning
services.limits: Not a permanent free tier; tenant/admin settings can block trial activation
services.commercialUse: Evaluation/trial terms apply

services.name: Snowflake Trial
services.quota: $400 Snowflake AI Data Cloud credits
services.goodFor: Warehouse, Snowpark, Streamlit, data sharing, Cortex and Snowflake data-engineering practice
services.limits: Credits expire after the trial; not an ongoing free tier
services.commercialUse: Evaluation terms apply

services.name: AWS Free Plan
services.duration: Up to 6 months or until credits are used
services.quota: $100 initial credits + up to $100 earned credits; 30+ services also expose monthly free usage limits
services.goodFor: Broad AWS exploration and short-lived proof-of-concept infrastructure
services.limits: The Free account plan closes at 6 months or when credits are exhausted; this is not a forever-free VM
services.commercialUse: Free-plan/evaluation terms apply

services.name: Visual Studio Code
services.quota: Unlimited local editor use under Microsoft VS Code license
services.goodFor: Python, SQL, dbt, notebooks, remote development, Git and extension-based workflows
services.limits: Extensions can have separate licenses/services
services.commercialUse: Yes, subject to the VS Code license

services.name: PyCharm Core
services.quota: Core Python development + basic Jupyter support; 30-day Pro trial is included initially
services.goodFor: Python, notebooks and local data-engineering development
services.limits: Advanced Pro functionality requires subscription after the trial
services.commercialUse: Core free features may be used commercially

services.name: DataGrip Non-Commercial
services.quota: Full DataGrip feature set for eligible non-commercial usage
services.goodFor: SQL/NoSQL querying, schema exploration, database IDE workflows and learning
services.limits: Commercial work requires a commercial license
services.commercialUse: No, non-commercial use only

services.name: Tabular Editor 2
services.quota: MIT-licensed desktop tool
services.goodFor: Power BI / Analysis Services semantic-model metadata editing and scripting
services.limits: TE3-only premium editor/debugger features are not included
services.commercialUse: MIT license

services.name: DAX Studio
services.quota: Local tool; no usage quota
services.goodFor: DAX queries, Server Timings, VertiPaq analysis, Power BI model performance tuning
services.limits: Windows/.NET-oriented desktop tooling
services.commercialUse: Open-source tool; verify component licenses if redistributing

services.name: dbt local / dbt OSS
services.quota: No user-count limit for local dbt; dbt OSS is Apache 2.0 subset
services.goodFor: Local SQL transformation, CI pipelines and self-managed analytics engineering
services.limits: You manage execution, scheduling, secrets and infrastructure yourself
services.commercialUse: Yes for internal/company use under current dbt licensing; check hosted-service restrictions

services.name: Apache Airflow
services.quota: Self-hosted; infrastructure is your responsibility
services.goodFor: DAG orchestration, scheduling, sensors and cross-system workflows
services.limits: Operational overhead compared with managed orchestration
services.commercialUse: Apache 2.0

services.name: OpenTofu
services.quota: Self-hosted CLI
services.goodFor: Terraform-style infrastructure as code without a hosted control-plane requirement
services.limits: State, runners, policy and collaboration are your responsibility unless paired with other services
services.commercialUse: Open source

services.name: k3s
services.quota: Self-hosted lightweight Kubernetes
services.goodFor: Learning Kubernetes on small VMs, edge devices and homelabs
services.limits: You still need compute; management is your responsibility
services.commercialUse: Open source
